body:
## Observed gap

Required English monolingual base-form compatibility is failed in prototype #8, reproducing #3. On the combined Android reader, hold `flowers` in the authored English EPUB. GCIDE returns honest no-entry output, although exact `flower` is present. The English-to-Spanish package supplies a `.syn` alias and correctly resolves the same selection to `flower`.

The current base-form source is package `.syn` only. This is an app/package limitation, independent of Readium selection/rendering. The public dictionary test passes its honest-missing assertion; that does not pass plural compatibility.

## Evidence and reproduction

[Dictionary evidence](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/blob/prototype/android-reader/docs/evidence/issue-3/README.md), [public combined checks](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/blob/prototype/android-reader/docs/evidence/issue-8/audit-report.md), combined Android results tracked in [#8](https://github.com/camilopaezz/reader-ldx/issues/8).

Use pinned full GCIDE archive SHA256 `be3c1293e3ebcd9bfbfea24b0a73381def27be665dec4c23c03896d4b42ab7f1`, import en→en, open CC0 foundation English EPUB, hold `flowers`, then compare exact `flower`. Fixture sources/licences/acquisition are in `fixtures/dictionaries/manifest.json`. Run offline with the recorded Android16/API36 and Readium3.1.2 setup.

## Proposed next step

Investigate explicit offline English base-form candidates for packages lacking aliases. Validate any candidate against the imported package and display the matched headword. Preserve exact-first behavior, accents/spelling and honest missing results. Do not use lexical-neighbor fallback or unvalidated suffix stripping. Record ambiguity and unsupported forms rather than claiming universal morphology.

Affected checks are native English plural lookup, supported base-form headword display and book-language monolingual definition. Add focused public input/output cases and Android selection/lookup evidence for the chosen approach before changing their status.

This follow-up is for triage. The prototype adoption gate remains FAILED; this issue does not revise parent #1 or approve a new morphology implementation.

comments.body: Owner-requested investigation assigned to GPT-6.1-Sol medium in isolated branch prototype/09-english-base-forms, based on integrated commit 6bf9887. This agent owns DictionaryPackage.kt, bounded base-form evaluation and focused public dictionary tests. Exact-first lookup, validated headwords and honest unsupported/ambiguous results remain required. It starts with host checks; Android verification waits for #10 to release the exclusive emulator lease. It will not edit selection/menu ownership. This assignment does not approve a broad morphology redesign or change parent requirements. The #8 gate remains failed pending actual checks and review.

title: Investigate offline English base forms for dictionaries without aliases
